tuples.subject: apr_disclosure
tuples.quote: 74.2 HFCs shall transparently HFCs shall transparently disclose to the borrower all information about fees/ charges payable for all information about fees/ processing the loan application, the amount of fees charges payable for refundable if loan amount is not sanctioned/ processing the loan disbursed, pre-payment options and charges, if any, application, the amount of penal charges for delayed repayment, if any, fees refundable if loan conversion charges for switching loan from fixed to amount is not sanctioned/ floating rates or vice-versa, existence of any interest disbursed, pre-payment reset clause and any other matter which affects the options and charges, if interest of the borrower.
